GOV_001.speaker: Government Official
GOV_001.text: Good morning. I am here on behalf of the city government. I have an official notice regarding this village and your property.

GOV_002.speaker: Government Official
GOV_002.text: Because the city is expanding, the government plans to requisition this land for future development.

GOV_003.speaker: Government Official
GOV_003.text: Residents are being given one year to decide what they will do. You have two legal options.

GOV_004.speaker: Government Official
GOV_004.text: Option one: leave within one year. During that time, you may deal with your house, farm, and belongings. After the deadline, the government will provide financial compensation. If the property is not vacated, forced demolition may be carried out.

GOV_005.speaker: Government Official
GOV_005.text: Option two: buy the land back. If you can pay the required repurchase amount before the deadline, you may keep the property and remain here.

GOV_006.speaker: Government Official
GOV_006.text: I understand this is a difficult decision. What would you like to say?

choices.text: How much does the land cost?
What if I choose to leave?
Why is the city taking our land?
What if I miss the deadline?
I refuse to give up my farm.

PLAYER_001.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_001.text: I need some time to understand all of this. A year sounds long, but this place is my home.

PLAYER_GOV_D2_PRICE.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_GOV_D2_PRICE.text: How much will I have to pay to buy back the farm?

PLAYER_GOV_D2_LEAVE.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_GOV_D2_LEAVE.text: What happens if I decide to move away?

PLAYER_GOV_D2_REASON.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_GOV_D2_REASON.text: Why does the city need our village in the first place?

PLAYER_GOV_D2_DEADLINE.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_GOV_D2_DEADLINE.text: What happens if I cannot get the money before the year is over?

PLAYER_GOV_D2_REFUSE.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_GOV_D2_REFUSE.text: I won't just give up my home. Is there anything we can do?

GOV_007.speaker: Government Official
GOV_007.text: Of course. You do not have to make the final decision today. The deadline is one year from the date of this notice.

GOV_D2_PRICE_001.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_PRICE_001.text: The city has set the repurchase price at {buyback_price} coins. You must pay that full amount before the year ends.

GOV_D2_LEAVE_001.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_LEAVE_001.text: You have one year to pack your belongings and leave the property. You may use that time to settle your affairs.

GOV_D2_REASON_001.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_REASON_001.text: The city's expansion plan includes this village. I know people have built their lives here, but I have no authority to change the project.

GOV_D2_DEADLINE_001.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_DEADLINE_001.text: If the full repurchase payment is not completed within a year, the city will proceed with the requisition order.

GOV_D2_REFUSE_001.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_REFUSE_001.text: I understand why you want to protect this place, but refusing the notice alone will not stop the process.

GOV_008.speaker: Government Official
GOV_008.text: The repurchase price has been set by the city. You must pay the full amount before the one-year deadline.

GOV_D2_PRICE_002.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_PRICE_002.text: You may earn the money through crops, fishing, or trade. How you raise it is up to you; the deadline will not change.

GOV_D2_LEAVE_002.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_LEAVE_002.text: The city will provide financial compensation after the deadline, according to the notice. Remaining on the property could lead to forced clearance.

GOV_D2_DEADLINE_002.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_DEADLINE_002.text: If the property has not been vacated, the city may send demolition robots to clear it. That is why the deadline matters.

GOV_D2_REFUSE_002.speaker: Government Official
GOV_D2_REFUSE_002.text: You may speak with the village chief and your neighbors. But to legally keep the farm, the city still requires the full repurchase payment.

GOV_009.speaker: Government Official
GOV_009.text: If the payment is completed in time, the requisition order for your property will be withdrawn and the land will remain yours.

PLAYER_002.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_002.text: Then I still have a chance. If I can earn enough money before the deadline, I can protect this place.

GOV_010.speaker: Government Official
GOV_010.text: You have a difficult year ahead. Whatever you decide, please remember that the deadline will not change.

GOV_END_001.speaker: Government Official
GOV_END_001.text: Everything you need is written in the notice. I will return later to check your decision. I hope you use your time wisely.

PLAYER_END_001.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_END_001.text: One year... I need to decide whether to leave, earn enough to buy the land back, or find another way to save our home.
PLAYER_END_001.notify: Start main quest: Save the Land
